title: avi-day-log-quick-tasks-2026-03-13
content:
Morning brain dump (10 min):
- Stretch, 5 min breathing (stand up).
- Grocery: almond milk, bananas, cold brew concentrate, phone charger (USB-C), band-aids.
- Drop off dry cleaning before 5pm (corner of 9th & Maple).
- Call landlord re: thermostat (voicemail left Monday).

Work priorities (block out calendar):
1) 11:00-11:30 — Sync with Jon: rollout gating for v1.4. Notes to bring: RED-872 canary plan, fallback policy sketch, cost delta from quantization-2.
   - Agenda: confirm canary routes, decide on model variant labels (gptx-8q vs gptx-8q-fast), agree SLA for canary (95p latency target).
   - Action items: me -> draft canary config; Jon -> metric dashboard filters; Maya -> add traces to span sampler.
2) 13:30-14:30 — Deep work on batcher tuning PR (do not multitask). Focus: reduce tail latency for short prompts while preserving throughput.
   - TODO: repro steps for local perf test, add synthetic seq-length distribution, run with batcher/window sizes: [8,16,32].
3) 16:00 — Quick stand with infra to confirm node pool labels for dedicated fleets.

Random notes / reminders to self:
- Try the new quantize script on small model first. Use quant level 4 -> compare perplexity on eval-set quick_prompts_v2.
- Add a check to avoid falling back to gptx-16 on low-memory nodes (bug seen yesterday). Put guard in router code path.
- PR checklist before merging: unit tests, perf benchmark commit, changelog entry, migrate-runbook updated.

Errands (after work):
- Pick up dry cleaning (5:10pm).
- Stop by FedEx for return label.
- Replace kitchen lightbulb (Philips A19) if hardware store open.

Personal TODO (small wins):
- Send birthday card to Priya (stamp? check envelope stash).
- Order replacement running shoes (save one pair for rainy runs).

Tiny experiments & ideas (brainstorm, raw):
- Could we add a "fast-path" routing tag for prompts < 32 tokens that prefer low-latency kernels? Might be able to auto-route to small-k cache-backed GPU pool. Sketch: sample 1% traffic and measure delta.
- Idea: introduce "office hours" slot in calendar app for cross-team debugging (1 hr/week). Invite: eng-serving, infra, product-ops.

Quick links I keep banging into:
- Internal perf dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/latency?env=canary
- RED-872 (PR): https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/872
- Test dataset: gs://redwood-evals/quick_prompts_v2

End-of-day checklist:
- Merge small docs into canary runbook if approved.
- Post one-line update to #eng-runtime: "Canary config drafted, perf tests queued."
- Tidy desk for tomorrow (clear two coffee mugs).

Notes to self (fragments):
- "If latency spikes on short prompts, check batching hysteresis and KV cache miss rates."
- "Remember: PM asked for cost estimate by Fri — rough numbers only."
- "Buy better cable management for laptop desk"

Timestamped quick log: 2026-03-13 08:45 - started sketch. 09:50 - wrote canary stub. 10:12 - interrupted by Slack, resumed deep work plan.

---
Unpolished, will clean up after Jon sync.
